correctness.rationale: For n>=7 the squared cycle has precisely the cyclic consecutive triples as triangles. Kim and Kim (arXiv:2101.01850v1), Theorem 3.1, supplies mod-two homology concentration for the identical cyclic triple hypergraph, which implies rational concentration by universal coefficients. The signed reduced Lefschetz trace of every group element is minus the explicitly computed orbit-assignment partition function; a characteristic-polynomial transfer computation yields every rotation trace, and palindromic boundary transfer yields both types of reflection. The resulting characters agree with the stated rational modules, with rank determined independently by Euler characteristic. Actual standalone code checks all small dihedral elements, mod-two boundaries, orientation signs and matrix recurrences. No integral homotopy or torsion assertion is made.

value.rationale: This gives a complete infinite-family equivariant topological invariant with a nontrivial two-dimensional quarter-turn representation for 4|n and alternating reflection characters in the rank-one families. The 2021 Betti numbers cannot recover this module; exact reflection signs distinguish symmetries at fixed homology rank. The object is a canonical cyclic triple-hypergraph/clique-free graph complex, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
